<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}/email-verifications"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Sends a verification link to the credentials' email address.

The credentials must have an `Email`. A verified address lets the person reset their own web
portal password. `EmailVerified` becomes `true` only when they follow the link.

Each call sends a new link, whether or not the address is already verified. Repeat sends to the
same address are rate limited: an immediate retry returns `429`, so wait a few minutes.
